status_note: The five targeted projections (SUBPIECE pullback through the MULTIEQUAL in-branch blocks P1/P1b, pullback cache P3, cross-block immediate-dominator pullback P2, constant-input pullback P5, and the testOpRead admission gate G1-G8) are byte-identical MATCH over 14 records, but the execute/doReplacement/removeFromFlowSplit integration over pullback outputs remains UNTESTED under CFG-0001, so the fixture-level B2 status is UNTESTED.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: pullbackOp (condexe.cc:160-190) returns the new output Varnode pointer and caches it in pullback[inbranch] (cc:188); the duplicate op is created via fd->newOp(numInput, op->getAddr()) (cc:180), its output via fd->newVarnodeOut(size, origOut->getAddr(), newOp) (cc:182) preserving the original address AND space, installed with opSetInput(op, invn, 0) plus the cc:185-186 input-copy loop, and inserted with opInsertEnd (cc:187). testOpRead (cc:107-142) returns bool. State is shared through fd (PcodeOpBank uniqid, VarnodeBank trees, block op lists) and the pullback cache; no other out-params.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: pullbackOp copies inputs with for(int4 i=1;i<op->numInput();++i) (cc:185); the inbranch leg reads defOp->getIn(inbranch) only when defOp->getParent()==iblock (cc:170-173), otherwise bl=iblock->getImmedDom() (cc:175/178). opInsertEnd (funcdata_op.cc:435-446) positions at endOp() minus one only when the last op is a flow break. testOpRead gates INT_ADD/PTRSUB input-1 constancy (cc:126-128) BEFORE the upop parent/code check (cc:131-133) and the isFree check (cc:135-136); the COPY short-circuit runs first (cc:123).
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: PcodeOpBank::uniqid increments once per newOp (SeqNum time; op.cc:941-948), so duplicate SeqNum times are monotone across P1(7), P1b(8), P2(13), P5(17) in fixture op-creation order; VarnodeBank create_index increments per varnode; pullback[inbranch] is written once per inbranch per doReplacement cycle (cleared at cc:323) and the P3 cache hit returns the identical Varnode pointer without consuming uniqid.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: VarnodeBank loc/def trees order by (space, offset, size, input/written/free class, def SeqNum) with the -1 trick putting free varnodes last (varnode.cc:34-53), so two WRITTEN varnodes at the same storage address (P1: the original SUBPIECE output register:300/4 and its duplicate) coexist keyed by their defining ops' SeqNums; block op order is list order, so END insertion is distinguishable from BEGIN insertion by index.

overlays.policy: primary file under test; hash-verify before replacing the pinned base copy

rugra_source.archive_policy: Immutable explicit dependency closure plus one hash-verified source overlay; unrelated worktree files are excluded

analysis_options.funcdata: One synthetic Funcdata over FixtureArchitecture; no followFlow, no Action pass; synthetic BlockBasic graph plus COPY / MULTIEQUAL / SUBPIECE / INT_ADD / PTRSUB / CBRANCH ops at explicit pc and storage addresses; Heritage::buildInfoList precondition replicated (the real pipeline populates Heritage::infolist during the first heritage() pass, which buildHeritageArray reads)
analysis_options.case_matrix: pullback P1/P1b: SUBPIECE over an iblock MULTIEQUAL through inbranch 0 and 1 (target block = iblock->In(inbranch), input 0 = MULTIEQUAL slot, original output in REGISTER space, target block has a leading COPY and trailing CBRANCH so END insertion lands between them); P3: pullback cache hit on the same inbranch; P2: input 0 defined outside the iblock -> immediate dominator target, original output in UNIQUE space; P5: constant (unwritten) input 0 -> immediate dominator target, empty target block; gate G1-G8: testOpRead admission matrix over INT_ADD/PTRSUB constant vs var input 1, non-MULTIEQUAL in-iblock definer, free/constant input 0, MULTIEQUAL input 0, COPY writeOp
analysis_options.normalization: Only block creation ordinals (bN) and varnode storage (space:offset/size) replace raw pointers; SeqNum times, block indices, op counts and booleans are byte-compared

observation_schema.format: 14 fixed-order pipe-delimited UTF-8 records with final newline
observation_schema.pullback_projection: For each pullbackOp call: target block creation ordinal, index within the block op list, block op count, duplicate opcode, SeqNum pc:time, output storage space:offset/size, input-0 and input-1 storage; P0 additionally records the pre-pullback iblock op count and the ORIGINAL SUBPIECE output storage; P3 records cache-pointer identity and unchanged op counts
observation_schema.preserved: No storage address, space, SeqNum time, block index, op count or boolean is normalized; only raw pointers are replaced by creation ordinals

build.oracle_archive: Exact locked Ghidra commit archive and locked Makefile libdecomp.a
build.access_leverage: #define private public + #define class struct (ConditionalExecution uses the implicit class-private section; pullbackOp/testOpRead and the iblock member are driven directly)
build.rust_build: Cargo --locked --offline in isolated target, then rustc with the librugra_sleigh native link

pullback_subpiece_multiequal.covers: P0/P1/P1b: pullbackOp (condexe.cc:160-190) through an iblock MULTIEQUAL for inbranch 0 and 1 — target block iblock->In(inbranch) (cc:171), input 0 from the MULTIEQUAL slot (cc:172), duplicate at the original op address (cc:180), output at the original REGISTER-space address (cc:182), opInsertEnd between the leading COPY and trailing CBRANCH (cc:187; funcdata_op.cc:435-446), SeqNum pc:time pinned

pullback_cache.covers: P3: findPullback cache (condexe.cc:146-152/163-165/188) returns the identical Varnode for a repeated inbranch and inserts no new op

pullback_crossblock_immeddom.covers: P2: input 0 defined outside the iblock -> bl = iblock->getImmedDom() (cc:175) and the duplicate preserves a UNIQUE-space original output address (cc:182), catching both the anonymous-unique and Register-pinning storage defects

pullback_const_input.covers: P5: unwritten (constant) input 0 -> bl = immedDom (cc:177-179), constant passed through as duplicate input 0, END insertion into an otherwise-empty block still precedes the trailing CBRANCH

gate_test_op_read.covers: G1-G8: testOpRead admission matrix (condexe.cc:107-142) — INT_ADD/PTRSUB non-constant input 1 rejected (cc:126-128), non-MULTIEQUAL in-iblock input-0 definer rejected (cc:131-133), free/constant input 0 rejected (cc:135-136), MULTIEQUAL input 0 and COPY writeOps admitted

execute_and_flow_split.covers: ConditionalExecution::execute / doReplacement consuming pullback outputs, and removeFromFlowSplit, are not exercised (CFG-0001 owns the corrected flow-split sequence); doReplacement's RETURN-leg newVarnodeOut storage preservation (condexe.cc:340-349) is likewise not projected here

branches.detail: execute/doReplacement/removeFromFlowSplit interaction with pullbackOp outputs needs CFG-0001's corrected removeFromFlowSplit before it can be projected; the doReplacement RETURN-leg newVarnodeOut preservation (condexe.cc:340-349) should be covered by the same follow-up
